; Detailed MiniMap - English
; Key = text, UTF-8. A missing key falls back to en.txt, then to the key itself.
; Name is how the language is listed in the menu.

Name = English
Intro = A detailed 3D map built from the world's real meshes: ground, houses, stairs, rocks, furniture.
Language = Language
Enabled = Map enabled
ToggleKey = Show / hide minimap:
PressKey = Press a key or a combination... (Esc - cancel)
KeyNone = none
SecMinimap = Minimap
Shape = Minimap shape
Square = Square
Round = Round
Corner = Corner rounding, px
NorthUp = Don't rotate the minimap
Size = Minimap size, px
RangeOutside = Minimap range outdoors
RangeInside = Minimap range in caves and houses
Tilt = Minimap tilt, degrees
SecIcons = Icons
IconSize = Icon size
IconFadeIn = Icon fade-in, s
IconFadeOut = Icon fade-out, s
AtOnce = instant
SecCut = Cutaway
CutCover = Cut away ceilings indoors
CutHeight = Cut height in caves and houses
Style = Map style
StyleColour = Colour
StyleVanilla = Vanilla
SecGround = Ground
GroundColor = Ground colour
GroundBrightness = Ground brightness
GroundOpacity = Ground opacity
Grid = Grid on the ground
GridStep = Grid step
Contours = Contour lines
ContourStep = Contour step
LineBrightness = Line brightness
SecGeometry = Geometry
GeometryColor = Geometry colour
GeometryBrightness = Geometry brightness
GeometryOpacity = Geometry opacity
SecRoadsWater = Roads and water
Roads = Roads
RoadColor = Road colour
RoadWidth = Road width
Water = Water
WaterColor = Water colour
SecOther = Other
DepthShade = Darken lower levels
FadeTime = Fade-in time, s
ResetLook = Reset look to defaults
TabMap = Map
TabLook = Look
Enemies = Enemies
Guards = Guards
Residents = Residents
Followers = Followers
Animals = Animals
Doors = Doors
Food = Food
Potions = Potions
Chests = Chests
Weapons = Weapons
Armor = Armour
Loot = Loot
Quests = Quests
Bodies = Bodies
Plants = Plants
SecPosition = Position
Anchor = Screen corner
TopLeft = Top left
TopRight = Top right
BottomLeft = Bottom left
BottomRight = Bottom right
OffsetX = Horizontal offset, px
OffsetY = Vertical offset, px
SecQuests = Quests
QuestBeam = Beam to the quest target
BeamKey = Show / hide beam:
LocalMap = Use this map instead of the local map
SecDebug = Diagnostics
DebugLog = Detailed log (DetailedMiniMap.log)
LocalMapKey = Open the local map:
ZoomInKey = Zoom minimap in:
ZoomOutKey = Zoom minimap out:
